name: remote-compute
description: Register remote machines (SSH, key-only) as user-level compute resources, advertise them to projects, and dispatch jobs/capability bundles to them. Requires the spec-workflow plugin (project overlay + config loader).

interface.shortDescription: Register SSH machines and dispatch remote compute jobs.
interface.longDescription: Register key-based SSH machines, advertise them to projects, and dispatch declared jobs and capability bundles. Requires the spec-workflow plugin to manage project-local availability and configuration.
defaultPrompt: Show the remote compute machines available to this project.
Dispatch a declared job to a remote machine.
